title: Spin–spin splitting in ethyl ethanoate
caption: The n + 1 rule: a signal is split into n + 1 lines by n equivalent hydrogens on the neighbouring carbon. The ethyl group gives a quartet (CH₂, next to CH₃) and a triplet (CH₃, next to CH₂); the CH₃ attached to C=O has no neighbouring H, so it is a singlet.
alt: Spectrum: triplet at 1.3 ppm (3H), singlet at 2.0 ppm (3H), quartet at 4.1 ppm (2H).
description: δ 2.0, 3H, singlet: CH₃ next to C=O.
δ 4.1, 2H, quartet: CH₂ next to O.
